title: Employ staff under the Concrete Products Award 2020
what: Pay and employ staff at no less than the terms of the Concrete Products Award 2020.

sources.title: Concrete Products Award 2020
sources.quote: 4.1 This industry award covers employers throughout Australia in the concrete products industry and their employees in the classifications listed in Schedule A —Classification Definitions .

reach.note: National system employers that are companies, in every state.

sources.title: Concrete Products Award 2020
sources.quote: 4.2 The concrete products industry means the fabrication or manufacture of cement products or concrete products including concrete panels, concrete pipes, monier or concrete tubs, baths, sinks, ventilating shafts, troughs, blocks, rollers, tiles, pavers, slabs, gutter bridges, plates, pile armours, bridge piles and similar articles and preparing reinforcement of steel or wire for use in making such articles.

sources.title: Which system of employment laws applies
sources.publisher: Government of Western Australia (Private Sector Labour Relations)
sources.quote: The state system covers: Private sector businesses and their employees that operate as: Sole traders. Partnerships, where none of the partners in the business is a constitutional corporation (trading or financial corporation).

assessment.summary: The Concrete Products Award sets the industry's classifications, minimum pay, allowances and penalty rates on top of the National Employment Standards.

marks.reason: Classifications, allowances, penalty rates and their record-keeping add to the cost and complexity of employing in the industry.
